scope: Own Search cycle only; metadata arithmetic, no evaluations repeated.

baseline.rule: Use final total once, not as-run plus final; preserve both original records.

geometry_and_helper_categories.note: Shadow field points are a top-level workload; do not add them again to nested helper calls. Original mask points and their helper counter describe the same calls, not extra work.

images_and_composites.presentation: Saved-array figures and resizing are not new candidate composites; no final media.

metrics.baseline_count_source: Sealed observe.py calls metrics twice on each of two completed references; each scores call has five SSIM Gaussian operations and one erosion. No rerun.

correspondence.scope: Counts describe diagnostic array reductions; no optical remapping, new photography or additional image produced.

fixed_crop_pixel_pairs_static_count.note: Paired target/output crop positions, not unique pixels or optical queries; derived from sealed driver calls and fixed rectangles, no new reductions. Mask/detail arithmetic reuses these crops.

cross_control_excluded.expanded_contrast_peer: Two candidate and two identity cached composites in pre-cycle peer review; zero rays/queries/filters/fits. Not Search science.
cross_control_excluded.expanded_outline_peer: Saved partial audit only; zero numerical optical evaluations or composites. Do not inherit root rays/Fresnel counts.

independent_primary_Search_replay_exclud: Primary two identities/two candidates and its mask/metric work are separately owned verification, not helper Search totals.
